title: Potential PrintNightmare Exploitation Attempt
rules_yaml:
title: Initial Access via Unauthenticated SMB NULL Session to srvsvc Named Pipe
id: 5f4b8d9a-2c3d-4e5f-6a7b-8c9d0e1f2a3b
status: experimental
description: Detects initial access using an unauthenticated SMB NULL session to access the srvsvc named pipe, a key step in CVE-2021-1675 exploitation.
references:
    - https://github.com/cube0x0/CVE-2021-1675
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1547/012/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1046/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-13
tags:
    - attack.initial_access
    - attack.privilege_escalation
    - attack.t1547.012
    - attack.t1046
logsource:
    category: pipe_created
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        PipeName|endswith: '\srvsvc'
        Image|endswith: '\svchost.exe'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative tools accessing named pipes
    - System services using srvsvc
level: high

title: Execution of CVE-2021-1675.py Exploit Script
id: 9a8b7c6d-5e4f-3g2h-1i0j-9k8l7m6n5o4p
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of the CVE-2021-1675.py exploit script, which is used to leverage the PrintNightmare vulnerability for privilege escalation.
references:
    - https://github.com/cube0x0/CVE-2021-1675
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1547/012/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-13
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.privilege_escalation
    - attack.t1547.012
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\python.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: 'CVE-2021-1675.py'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate Python scripts using similar naming conventions
    - Security research tools
level: high

title: Registry Modification for PointAndPrint Policy Settings
id: 1b2c3d4e-5f6g-7h8i-9j0k-1l2m3n4o5p6q
status: experimental
description: Detects registry modifications related to PointAndPrint policy settings, which are necessary for enabling the PrintNightmare exploit.
references:
    - https://github.com/cube0x0/CVE-2021-1675
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1547/012/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-13
tags:
    - attack.privilege_escalation
    - attack.persistence
    - attack.t1547.012
logsource:
    category: registry_event
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        TargetObject|contains: 'HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Printers\PointAndPrint'
        Details|contains:
            - 'RestrictDriverInstallationToAdministrators'
            - 'NoWarningNoElevationOnInstall'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate system administration activities
    - Security configuration management tools
level: high

title: Citrix ADS Exploitation CVE-2020-8193 CVE-2020-8195
rules_yaml:
title: Citrix ADC XXE Injection via Unauthenticated HTTP POST
id: 55555555-5555-5555-5555-555555555555
status: experimental
description: Detects exploitation of Citrix ADC vulnerability via unauthenticated HTTP POST to /citrix/adc/portal/ with crafted XML data triggering XXE injection.
references:
    - https://support.citrix.com/article/CTX276688
    - https://research.nccgroup.com/2020/07/10/rift-citrix-adc-vulnerabilities-cve-2020-8193-cve-2020-8195-and-cve-2020-8196-intelligence/
    - https://dmaasland.github.io/posts/citrix.html
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1190/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-13
tags:
    - attack.initial-access
    - attack.t1190
logsource:
    category: webserver
    product: apache
    service: access
    version: 2.4
detection:
    selection:
        cs-method: POST
        cs-uri-stem: /citrix/adc/portal/
        cs-uri-query: null
        request_body|contains:
            - '<!DOCTYPE'
            - 'ENTITY'
            - 'xml'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative tools accessing the Citrix ADC portal endpoint
    - Automated health checks or monitoring scripts
level: high
